what_it_is: The enacted budget law or appropriation act, with its schedules.
The line-item estimates volumes: as tabled, or as approved where the cover says so.
The medium-term expenditure or fiscal framework, or a budget framework paper; forward ceilings, not a vote.
An in-year or year-end budget execution or outturn report from the finance ministry.
The audited public accounts, or the auditor-general's or audit court's report on them.
An extract from the government's own IFMIS or open-budget portal.
A treasury warrant, release or cash-allocation notice to a ministry or agency.
The board-approved budget of a levy fund, regulator or state-owned enterprise.
A ministry's or agency's procurement plan; evidences intent to spend, not a budget stage.
A decree, despacho, ordinance or supplementary-credit order; enacts a budget where no parliament sits.
A financier's appraisal or financing document stating the government's counterpart share.
The government's own statement: a budget speech, press release or official portal page.
On-the-record reporting of any of the above.
